observations_from_inspected_photos: Mounted originals show broad shallow numbered skirts and compact grips.
Isolated modern-part photos clearly show fine fluting; the prior generic chunky grip blocks were inaccurate.
Revision 0.2 removed the unsupported raised pointer bar, rebuilt the grip and draped its numerals over the sloping skirt.
Measurements and exact vintage artwork remain provisional.

Revision 0.3 re-inspected dated RetroFret/Folkway photographs and the modern Stars angle. Broader sampled fluting, continuous top lip, heavier lettering and more reflective dish; dimensions and vintage artwork remain estimates.
